messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: PAGE_SHIFT spike detected in pool=pool8 (dc-usw1) — 5 GPUs > 10 PAGE_SHIFT/min in last 15m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/alerts/1888888888

sanjay: saw this. adding affected cards to a short watchlist. I'll run a quick healthscan and propose drains for the worst offenders :eyes:

maya: thanks. can you paste the query you ran?

sanjay: run used:
```
SELECT gpu_id, count(*) as shifts, max(ecc_errors) as ecc FROM gpu_events
WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_SHIFT' AND pool='pool8' AND ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY gpu_id ORDER BY shifts DESC;
```

alex: good call. my rule: cordon + drain any node with shifts > 25 or ECC increasing trend (slope > 0.1/min). we should avoid mass-drains during peak for latency-sensitive tenants.

sanjay: results: g8-123 (37), g8-126 (29), g8-132 (22), g8-139 (12), g8-141 (11). ECC counters trending up on 123/126/132. I'll start with 123 and 126.

lina: created ticket INF-3421 and flagged for hardware replacement + page-retire evaluation. added nodes: g8-123,g8-126,g8-132. Notes: region=us-west-1, bucket=hw-logs/INF-3421

oncall-bot: Created incident INF-3421 and paged: @sanjay, @alex

sanjay: draining now. commands:
```
fleetctl cordon g8-123 && fleetctl drain g8-123 --timeout 900
fleetctl cordon g8-126 && fleetctl drain g8-126 --timeout 900
```

sanjay: quick healthcheck outputs (excerpt):
```
[g8-123] nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.corrected.volatile --format=csv
ECC_VOLATILE: 1243
Kernel log snippets: "NVRM: GPU at 0000:af:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 31" repeated
```

alex: once drained, tag them as `page_shift_candidate` in inventory and enqueue RMA with hw-team. I'll adjust capacity policy to route low-latency traffic to pool9 for the next 24h.

maya: run memtester on g8-132 before we RMA, sometimes soft errors are transient. command attached:
```
memtester 8G 2
```

sanjay: noted. memtester scheduled for g8-132 after maintenance window. uploading full logs to s3://infra-diagnostics/INF-3421/g8-123.log

lina: added watchlist entry and dashboard alert: `pool8.page_shift_rate > 10` triggers paging. also set a temporary autoscale buffer of +12% for pool8 to cover drained capacity.

alex: thanks. next steps: continue triage, RMA 123/126 if memtester/RMA confirms, monitor for any Xid 31 recurrence. postmortem template will go on the ticket if we see replacement.

sanjay: will update INF-3421 with outcomes. tagging @ops-hw for RMA.

maya: :thumbsup:

alex: :white_check_mark: keep us posted.
